recognize_zh: 未染色濕片（wet mount）中佈滿大小不一、完美圓形、中央透亮並帶深色折光邊緣的球體，彼此不含核或內部結構；這種高折光性的圓形液滴是脂肪球，符合檢體中含有脂肪顆粒（脂肪栓塞），可再以油紅 O 或 Sudan 染色確認。
features: Unstained wet mount viewed through the microscope eyepiece
Numerous perfectly round, smooth-contoured globules of widely varying size
Globules are homogeneous and clear centrally with dark, refractile rims
No nuclei, internal structure, or biconcave shape; no cell outlines within the globules
Globules crowd together without deforming into polyhedral shapes
describe_en: Unstained wet-mount preparation of material from the blood sample shows numerous round, smooth, homogeneous globules of widely varying size with clear centers and dark refractile rims. The globules lack nuclei or internal structure and do not have the biconcave shape of red cells. The appearance is characteristic of lipid droplets. In the clinical context of suspected fat embolism with analyzer interference and neutrophils containing fat vacuoles, the findings are consistent with fat globules in the specimen; confirmation with Oil red O or Sudan staining is recommended.

ddx.vs: Air bubbles have very thick, dark black rims with a bright center and usually lie in a different focal plane or at the coverslip edge, whereas lipid droplets have thinner refractile rims and stain with Oil red O.

ddx.dx: Red blood cells or red cell ghosts
ddx.vs: Red cells are uniform, about 7-8 µm, biconcave and pale pink-yellow, unlike the markedly variable-sized refractile globules here.
Starch granules are faceted with a central hilum and show a Maltese-cross pattern under polarized light, unlike smooth round lipid droplets.
